-- What a client importing `Proof.sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.NamedVocab` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def smd.ensureNamed (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (s : smd.PathSet) : smd.PathSet :=
  smd.FSet.union s (smd.FSet.bind (smd.namedAlong S [] (some t)) s)

def smd.typeAlong (S : smd.Schema) (t : Option smd.TypeRef) : smd.Path → Option smd.TypeRef :=
  List.brecOn (motive := fun x => Option smd.TypeRef → Option smd.TypeRef) x✝ (smd.typeAlong._f S) t

def smd.childType (S : smd.Schema) (t : Option smd.TypeRef) (pe : smd.PE) : Option smd.TypeRef :=
  match t.bind fun t => S.find t.name, pe with
  | some (smd.Atom.map fs e rel), smd.PE.field n => smd.fieldType fs e n
  | some (smd.Atom.list e rel keys), smd.PE.key fl => some e
  | x, x_1 => none

def smd.ensureNamedOpt (S : smd.Schema) (ty : Option smd.TypeRef) (s : smd.PathSet) : smd.PathSet :=
  smd.FSet.union s (smd.FSet.bind (smd.namedAlong S [] ty) s)

def smd.ensureNamedOpt_under.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (ty : Option smd.TypeRef) (s : smd.PathSet) (e : smd.PE),
    (smd.ensureNamedOpt S ty s).under e = smd.ensureNamedOpt S (smd.childType S ty e) (s.under e)

def smd.ensureNamedOpt_tops.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (ty : Option smd.TypeRef) (s : smd.PathSet) (e : smd.PE),
    e ∈ (smd.ensureNamedOpt S ty s).tops ↔
      e ∈ s.tops ∨
        e ∈ s.heads ∧
          ∃ n fs el rel,
            e = smd.PE.field n ∧
              (ty.bind fun t => S.find t.name) = some (smd.Atom.map fs el rel) ∧ (smd.lookupKV n fs).isSome = true

def smd.ensureNamed_opt.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (s : smd.PathSet), smd.ensureNamed S t s = smd.ensureNamedOpt S (some t) s

def smd.namedAlong (S : smd.Schema) (acc : smd.Path) (ty : Option smd.TypeRef) : smd.Path → List
    smd.Path :=
  List.brecOn (motive := fun x => smd.Path → Option smd.TypeRef → List smd.Path) x✝ (smd.namedAlong._f S) acc ty
